results.description: Every money movement is a balanced, append-only journal entry
results.expected: Deposit, transfer and withdrawal each post entries whose lines add up to zero; wallet balance equals its journal account; the database refuses to change a journal line
results.actual: 2 entries, balanced: true; wallet 4500 vs journal 4500.00; update refused: true

results.description: Hash-chained audit log
results.expected: An administrator decision is written to the audit log; the chain verifies; the database refuses to delete a record
results.actual: Alert 193 decided HTTP 200; audit records 1; chain verified: true (1034 records); delete refused: true

results.description: Idempotency keys stop a retried payment applying twice
results.expected: The same key twice moves the money once and replays the first response; the key with a different request is refused
results.actual: First HTTP 200 #7586; repeat HTTP 200 #7586, replayed: true; different body HTTP 422; balance 850

results.description: Live notification when money arrives
results.expected: The recipient's open page receives a notification event as soon as a transfer completes, and it is stored
results.actual: Event: "You received KES 120.00"; stored, unread 1

results.description: Sign-in from a new device
results.expected: The user is notified; payments from that device carry a new-device risk signal
results.actual: Flagged as new device: true; notification "New sign-in from Script on an unknown system"; payment HTTP 200 with new-device signal: true; devices listed 2

results.description: Two-factor sign-in
results.expected: After setting up an authenticator, sign-in needs a code: a wrong code is refused, the right one signs in, and a used code cannot be replayed
results.actual: Set-up QR: true; enable HTTP 200; password step HTTP 202; wrong code HTTP 401; right code HTTP 200; replayed code HTTP 401

results.description: Scam check and cooling-off
results.expected: A first transfer of KES 1,000 or more asks what it is for; an ordinary purpose sends it; a scam-pattern purpose holds it for a cooling-off period, during which the sender can cancel and get the money back
results.actual: Not run: needs RISK_MODE=enforce

results.description: Cooling-off payment is sent when the period ends
results.expected: Once the cooling-off time has passed, the payment is released to the recipient and the journal balances
results.actual: Not run: needs RISK_MODE=enforce

results.description: "This wasn't me" dispute, clawback and restore
results.expected: Disputing a payment freezes the account; upholding recovers what the recipient still holds and freezes the recipient; restoring lets the user pay again
results.actual: Dispute HTTP 201; withdrawal while frozen HTTP 423; upheld HTTP 200, recovered 900; recipient frozen: true; restore HTTP 200; withdrawal after HTTP 200; balance 3990

results.description: Two-person approval for large held payments
results.expected: Deciding a held payment of KES 10,000 or more needs two different administrators; the money moves only on the second approval
results.actual: Not run: needs RISK_MODE=enforce

results.description: Reporting an account warns other payers
results.expected: Only someone who has dealt with an account can report it; others then see a warning on the payee check; a second report by the same person is refused
results.actual: Report HTTP 201; repeat HTTP 409; from a stranger HTTP 403; payee warning: "Another SecureWallet user has reported this account. Check who you are paying before you continue."

results.description: Send money to a phone number
results.expected: A user links a Kenyan number (password needed); another user finds and pays them by that number
results.actual: Wrong password HTTP 403; linked 254779415080; lookup finds phoneb Test; payment HTTP 200

results.description: M-Pesa deposit by STK push (simulator)
results.expected: Accepting the phone prompt credits the wallet once, from external:mpesa in the journal; cancelling credits nothing; a callback with a wrong token is ignored
results.actual: STK HTTP 201 (ws_CO_261117143932413490747); paid: success, receipt S86D50CCC1; repeat callback still one credit; cancelled: failed (1032); balance 750; forged callback HTTP 404

results.description: USSD menu for feature phones
results.expected: The simulator refuses anyone not signed in and dials from their own number; balance needs the PIN; sending shows the recipient's registered name before the PIN and completes; the language switches to Swahili
results.actual: Without signing in: HTTP 401; menu "CON Welcome to SecureWallet"; wrong PIN "END Incorrect PIN. 4 attempts left."; balance "END Your balance is KES 900.00"; payee "CON Send to ussdb Test / Enter amount"; sent "END Sent KES 200.00 to ussdb Test. New balance KES 700.00. Ref SW-007602"; language "END Lugha imebadilishwa kuwa Kiswahili."

results.description: Chama: contributions and a majority-approved payout
results.expected: Members contribute to the pot; a payout needs a majority (2 of 2) and is paid only after the second approval; the pot has its own journal account
results.actual: Created HTTP 201; joined HTTP 200; payout proposed, needs 2; after second vote: paid; pot 300.00, journal 300.00

results.description: Fraud API with keys, decisions, rate limits and signed webhooks
results.expected: A client's key assesses payments; a burst is challenged; external_id makes calls safe to retry; a wrong key is refused; the rate limit applies; the webhook is signed correctly
results.actual: Client HTTP 201; first allow (asm_51); retry returns asm_51; 5th payment in a burst: challenge (4 payments out in the last 10 minutes; 4 payments to this recipient in the last 10 minutes); wrong key HTTP 401; label HTTP 200; webhook delivered, signature valid: true; with a limit of 3 a minute: 201, 201, 201, 429, 429

results.description: Retraining from decisions and shadow scoring
results.expected: Analyst decisions become labelled examples; retraining produces a challenger; later payments are also scored by the challenger in shadow; the challenger can be discarded
results.actual: Labels: {"alert":26,"dispute":6,"api":6,"fraud":16,"legit":22,"skipped":0}; job done; challenger rf-20261117-113937-38live; payment shadow-scored 0.82; discard HTTP 200

results.description: Drift between live payments and the training data
results.expected: The drift check reports a population stability index for each model feature
results.actual: HTTP 200; 500 payments; amount 8.2827, oldbalanceOrg 7.5416, newbalanceOrig 7.3776, oldbalanceDest 6.012, newbalanceDest 7.1151, type_encoded 3.9057, balance_discrepancy 6.4328

results.description: Retry queue scores payments made while the model was down
results.expected: An unscored transfer is scored later with the features recorded at the time; a risky one raises a late alert
results.actual: Queue scored 1, flagged 1; transaction scored, risk 0.867962; alert late_score

results.description: Money-flow network around an account
results.expected: The network view finds the accounts an account paid and was paid by, two hops out
results.actual: HTTP 200; 3 accounts, 2 flows; includes the second hop: true

results.description: Attack lab evaluation of every scenario
results.expected: Every attack step expected to be caught is caught; ordinary steps raise no false alarm
results.actual: Not run: needs RISK_MODE=enforce and ATTACK_LAB=1

results.description: Data export (right of access)
results.expected: The user downloads their data; it includes their transactions and devices and never the password, PIN or two-factor secret
results.actual: HTTP 200; 1 transactions, 1 devices; secrets absent: true

results.description: Usability survey (System Usability Scale)
results.expected: A completed questionnaire is scored on the 0 to 100 SUS scale; incomplete answers are refused; results are summarised for administrators
results.actual: Best answers score 100; middle answers 75; incomplete HTTP 400; summary of 12 responses, mean 87.5

results.description: Latency metrics
results.expected: /metrics is refused without credentials and gives Prometheus metrics, including model latency, to an administrator
results.actual: Anonymous HTTP 401; admin HTTP 200; model latency p50 20 ms, p95 32 ms over 30 calls

results.description: Reconciliation after every test
results.expected: The journal balances, both hash chains verify, and every wallet, savings goal, loan, chama and held payment matches its journal account
results.actual: OK: true; 6567 journal entries and 1093 audit records verified; 596 wallets checked; issues 0
